title: Lobby topic
description: One banner of the lobby's 最新トピック carousel. One record per file: topics/<id>.json.

kind.description: What the topic is about. Read out before the title; the banner itself carries the look.

path.description: Relative to topics/. A 21:9 image, at least 1260 px wide.

link.description: Where the banner leads: a work of the catalog (by id, so nothing about the work is repeated here), a page of the lobby, or an https page elsewhere.

from.description: Shown from this instant. Omitted: shown at once.

until.description: Shown until this instant. Omitted: no end.

enabled.description: false takes the topic down without deleting it. Omitted: true.

instant.description: A date and time with its offset from UTC written out, e.g. 2026-12-01T00:00:00+09:00. The offset is required so that the instant means the same everywhere.
